sum: OpenWorld, Inc. operates as a digital assets and blockchain innovation company. The company offers asset tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, capital markets advisory, governance structuring, and public markets strategy. It serves the Gulf, Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia. The company was founded in 2023 and is based in Camana Bay, the Cayman Islands.
ceo: Mr. Matthew Ian Shaw (Co-founder, CEO & Chairman)
